current_detections.name: Bullish Flag
current_detections.evidence: Strong impulsive upward move from approximately 0.918 to 0.945 around the 08:00 mark, followed by a tight downward/sideways consolidation forming a flag pattern. Current price at 0.9395 is within the flag formation.
